title: Extracting Single-Mode Rayleigh--Taylor Instability dynamics from data via SINDy
abstract: arXiv:2611.07666v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Rayleigh-Taylor instability (RTI) is of fundamental importance in fields such as inertial confinement fusion and supernova explosions, and its evolution is commonly described by potential--flow theory and buoyancy--drag models. However, both types of models struggle to accurately capture the overshoot behavior of bubble and spike velocities, as well as the subsequent reacceleration stage. To address these limitations, we develop a physics-constrained, data-driven framework based on the integral formulation of Sparse Identification of Nonlinear Dynamics (SINDy), which extracts low-dimensional dynamical equations for bubble and spike evolution directly from data. By introducing the nondimensional initial amplitude $A_0 = k\eta_0$ as an explicit parameter, we identify distinct dynamical equations for the bubble and the spike based on data spanning multiple Atwood numbers and initial amplitudes. translated_title: 基于SINDy从数据中提取单模瑞利-泰勒不稳定性动力学
translated_abstract: 瑞利-泰勒不稳定性（RTI）在惯性约束聚变和超新星爆发等领域具有基础性重要意义，其演化过程通常由势流理论和浮力-阻力模型来描述。然而，这两类模型都难以准确捕捉气泡和尖钉速度的过冲行为以及随后的再加速阶段。为解决这些局限性，我们开发了一个基于稀疏非线性动力学识别（SINDy）积分形式的物理约束数据驱动框架，直接从数据中提取气泡和尖钉演化的低维动力学方程。通过引入无量纲初始振幅 $A_0 = k\eta_0$ 作为显式参数，我们基于跨越多个阿特伍德数和初始振幅的数据，识别出了气泡和尖钉各自不同的动力学方程。所得到的低维动力学方程……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于SINDy积分形式的物理约束数据驱动框架，通过引入无量纲初始振幅作为显式参数，直接从数据中识别出能够刻画瑞利-泰勒不稳定性中气泡和尖钉演化（包括过冲与再加速阶段）的低维动力学方程，克服了传统势流理论和浮力-阻力模型的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a physics-constrained, data-driven framework based on the integral formulation of SINDy, which identifies low-dimensional dynamical equations for bubble and spike evolution in Rayleigh–Taylor instability directly from data by introducing the nondimensional initial amplitude as an explicit parameter, overcoming the limitations of traditional potential-flow and buoyancy–drag models.
